title: Hawthorn garden landscape
goal: Show planting, paths, tree canopies, water feature, and dimensions.

rubric.must: Residence, lawn, perennial border, and shrub border are visibly separate labelled areas.
The reflecting pond is visibly distinct and identified by a Water feature callout.
